According to the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Klikk]], an '''RX-series droid''' experienced a spectacular malfunction while on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] causing it to fly away with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on its own when its [[Unidentified RX-series pilot droid owner|owner]] stepped down from the [[Entry ramp/Legends|boarding ramp]]. Although the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] [[Naboo system observation post|observation post]] sent [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to stop the [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-series pilot droid]], it eluded them and jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], on course to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] housing the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="SGD 133">''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
